title: T1.2: Add import validation for story_type against types.toml

text: Acceptance: (1) src/app.rs: before import loop (~L725-730), call load_type_map(root)?. (2) Collect and validate ALL import_story.story_type values before loop — invalid types cause early Err(AppError::Validation). (3) Error message lists ALL invalid types, e.g. "unknown types: foo, bar. Available types: story, epic, bug, chore, task". (4) Zero stories created on validation failure (all-or-nothing). (5) New tests: import_rejects_invalid_story_type, import_atomicity_on_type_error, import_accepts_valid_story_type.
